help.description: Cross-check LLM serving arguments (vLLM, SGLang, TGI) against the Kubernetes pod spec: GPU count, /dev/shm, probe budget, Hugging Face cache and token. Fully offline.
help.epilog: Examples: 'kube-llm-lint deploy.yaml' or 'helm template my ./chart | kube-llm-lint - --format json --fail-on warning'. Exit codes: 0 = clean, 1 = findings at or above --fail-on, 2 = usage or input error.
help.paths: YAML files, directories (searched recursively for *.yaml and *.yml), or - to read stdin
help.help: show this help message and exit
help.lang: output language (default: KUBE_LLM_LINT_LANG, then LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG; English unless it starts with ko)
help.format: report format: text (default), json or sarif (SARIF 2.1.0)
help.fail_on: lowest severity that makes the exit code 1: error (default), warning, info or none
help.startup_budget: seconds a container may take to become healthy before probes restart it (default: {default})
help.disable: comma-separated rule ids to turn off, for example shm-missing,gpu-missing
help.list_rules: print every rule with its severity, source URL and the date it was checked, then exit
err.no_input: no input given. Pass YAML files, a directory, or - for stdin, for example: helm template my ./chart | kube-llm-lint -
err.not_found: cannot read {path}: no such file or directory. Check the path.
err.template: {path} looks like a Helm template (it contains '{marker}' and is not valid YAML). Render it first: helm template NAME ./chart | kube-llm-lint -
err.encoding: cannot read {path}: the file is not UTF-8 text. Re-save it as UTF-8 and run again.
err.no_yaml: {path} contains no *.yaml or *.yml files. Check the directory path.
err.arg_value: argument {option}: invalid value {value} (a whole number is expected)
err.bad_budget: --startup-budget must be a positive number of seconds, got {value}
err.unknown_rule: unknown rule id(s) in --disable: {rules}. Valid ids: {valid}
report.summary: Summary: errors {errors}, warnings {warnings}, info {infos} (serving containers checked: {containers}, files: {files})
rule.gpu-parallel-mismatch: GPUs needed by the parallel sizes must equal the GPUs the container requests.
rule.gpu-missing: A serving container should request a GPU resource.
rule.gpu-mig-unchecked: MIG resources do not map to parallel sizes, so they are not compared.
rule.shm-missing: More than one GPU needs /dev/shm larger than the 64MiB container default.
rule.shm-not-memory: The /dev/shm volume should be an emptyDir with medium: Memory.
rule.shm-too-small: The /dev/shm volume should be at least 1Gi.
rule.no-startup-probe: A liveness probe without a startupProbe can restart the container while the model loads.
rule.probe-budget-short: The startupProbe budget (delay + period x failureThreshold) is shorter than model loading needs.
rule.hf-cache-ephemeral: A model downloaded at start needs its cache on a persistent volume.
rule.hf-token-plaintext: The Hugging Face token should come from a Secret, not a literal value.
rule.mem-fraction-range: The GPU memory fraction must be a number in range.
rule.config-file-unchecked: Values inside a vLLM --config file are not read.
rule.arg-unresolved: A value that is a variable could not be resolved, so dependent checks are skipped.
msg.gpu-parallel-mismatch: GPUs needed: {required} ({formula}), but the container requests {gpus} ({resource}).
msg.gpu-missing: {server} server found but the container requests no GPU (nvidia.com/gpu or amd.com/gpu).
msg.gpu-mig-unchecked: container requests MIG resource {resource}; GPU count and parallel size are not compared.
msg.shm-missing: A setup with {required} GPUs needs shared memory for NCCL, but nothing is mounted at /dev/shm (container default is 64MiB). Add a memory-backed volume, set hostIPC: true, or set NCCL_SHM_DISABLE=1.
msg.shm-not-memory: volume '{volume}' mounted at /dev/shm is not an emptyDir with medium: Memory.
msg.no-startup-probe: liveness probe budget is {budget}s and there is no startupProbe. Loading a model can take longer than that, so the kubelet may restart the container while it loads (target: {target}s, change with --startup-budget).
msg.probe-budget-short: startupProbe budget is {budget}s, shorter than the {target}s target (initialDelaySeconds + periodSeconds x failureThreshold). Raise failureThreshold or change --startup-budget.
msg.hf-cache-ephemeral.nomount: model '{model}' is downloaded at start but nothing is mounted at its cache path {path}; every restart downloads it again.
msg.hf-cache-ephemeral.emptydir: model '{model}' is downloaded at start but its cache path {path} is on emptyDir volume '{volume}'; every restart downloads it again.
msg.hf-token-plaintext: {env} is set as a literal value ({masked}). Read it from a Secret with secretKeyRef.
msg.mem-fraction-range: {flag} is '{value}' but must be a number in {range}.
msg.config-file-unchecked: --config {file}: values inside the file are not checked.
msg.arg-unresolved: value of '{arg}' ('{value}') cannot be resolved statically; checks that need it are skipped.
fix.startup_probe: give model loading up to {budget}s before liveness takes over
fix.gpu: GPU count that matches the server arguments
fix.token: read the token from a Secret
fix.mem: use a fraction inside the allowed range
